### Solutions

- **[id 30]**
  - Ratio sum $= 7 + 11 = 18$ parts.
  - Value per part $= 162 / 18 = 9$.
  - Allen's current age $= 11 \times 9 = 99$.
  - Allen's age in 10 years $= 99 + 10 = 109$.

- **[id 31]**
  - First guess $= 80$.
  - Second guess $= (80 / 2) + 20 = 60$.
  - Third guess $= 80 \times 1.25 = 100$.
  - Average guess $= (80 + 60 + 100) / 3 = 240 / 3 = 80$.

- **[id 32]**
  - Hours per day $= 10 \times 0.5 = 5$ hours.
  - Hours per week $= 5 \times 7 = 35$ hours.

- **[id 33]**
  - Let $G$ be gold coins and $S$ be silver coins: $G + S = 110$ and $G - S = 30$.
  - $2G = 140 \implies G = 70$.

- **[id 34]**
  - Raymond has $40$ jewels.
  - Aaron has $(40 / 2) + 5 = 25$ jewels.
  - Siobhan has $25 - 2 = 23$ jewels.

- **[id 35]**
  - First 20 minutes $= 4$ points.
  - Second 20 minutes $= 4 \times 1.25 = 5$ points.
  - Total points $= 4 + 5 = 9$.

- **[id 36]**
  - Total yogurts $= 2 \times 30 = 60$ yogurts.
  - Number of 4-packs $= 60 / 4 = 15$.
  - Total cost $= 15 \times \$5 = \$75$.

- **[id 37]**
  - Money spent on games $= 8 \times \$20 = \$160$.
  - Total money from sales $= \$160 + \$5 = \$165$.
  - Lego sets sold $= 165 / 15 = 11$.
  - Lego sets remaining $= 13 - 11 = 2$.

- **[id 38]**
  - Total running time $= 3 + 1.5 + 1.5 = 6$ hours.
  - Speed $= 60 \text{ miles} / 6 \text{ hours} = 10$ mph.

- **[id 39]**
  - Skipping speed $= 3$ mph $\implies$ Running speed $= 3 / 0.5 = 6$ mph.
  - Walking speed $= 6 / 4 = 1.5$ mph.
  - Running time $= (1/3) \times 6 = 2$ hours $\implies 2 \times 6 = 12$ miles.
  - Walking time $= (2/3) \times 6 = 4$ hours $\implies 4 \times 1.5 = 6$ miles.
  - Total distance $= 12 + 6 = 18$ miles.
